title: Frustrating Experience with Repeated App Glitches
text:
Extremely disappointing experience with the HDFC Securities InvestRight app. The app seems to have a glitch almost every time when you need to update or manage something important.

Despite multiple attempts, I couldn’t complete a simple update. These recurring technical issues are frustrating, especially when dealing with investments and time-sensitive transactions.

For a reputed financial institution like HDFC Securities, such a poor user experience is unacceptable. The app needs serious improvement in terms of stability, performance, and customer convenience.

I hope the technical team takes these issues seriously and provides a reliable, glitch-free platform soon.
